review.tagline: Postgres-based backend platform that coding agents operate through an MCP server
review.summary: InsForge bundles Postgres, auth, S3-compatible storage, edge functions, an OpenAI-compatible model gateway and site deployment behind an MCP server. Coding agents read docs, schemas and logs, and run migrations, deploy functions and create buckets as tools. Self-hosting uses Docker Compose with generated secrets; a hosted cloud edition also exists.
review.audience: Developers giving coding agents a self-hosted or cloud backend
strengths: Covers auth, Postgres, storage, edge functions and model gateway in one stack
MCP server exposes schemas, logs and config so agents can verify their own work
Setup script generates JWT, encryption and database secrets into a mode 600 .env
Storage can use local disk, bundled MinIO or RustFS, or any S3-compatible store
weaknesses: CLI + Skills interface is cloud only; self-hosted gets the MCP server only
Compute (long-running containers) is in private preview
Resource requirements such as RAM are not documented in the README
Running several instances needs manual per-project names and port overrides
needs: Needs Docker with Compose v2, Postgres, S3-compatible store (optional)
Models: OpenAI-compatible gateway across multiple LLM providers
